blocks.text: Lakeshore inventory position API v1 requirements

This is the working cut for LSH-4401 on September 22, 2022. Luis Ortega asked for a written bound after the current path (Woo stock, nightly CSV, 6.1 hours stale by 11:30) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host inv-api.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on HelioCount GraphQL overlay, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Three GET endpoints against mysql-ro.lakeshore.internal. Store-scoped. No writes to POS. Reject HelioCount overlay ($41.2k, no store ACL). I am not restating a hallway yes. HelioCount GraphQL overlay is out because Quote was one tenant, any user saw all four stores. Luis killed it. Cost was also high for three reads. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at stores=4, stale=6.1, cost=41.2, endpoints=3, skus=18.4k, lag=14.8, weeks=9, mispick=29.6. Sibling tickets LSH-REQ-2022-014 and LSH-TDD-2022-022. I will not reopen HelioCount GraphQL overlay in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: pos-01.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (25): refuse on HelioCount GraphQL overlay, lock is three GET, store ACL, replica only, Elkhart first. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-REQ-2022-014.
I need on-hand at Elkhart during the shift, not the Woo number from last night.

What a skeptical user would try first on inv-api.lakeshore.internal: the path Luis Ortega actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on mysql-ro.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

I will not claim HelioCount GraphQL overlay is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host inv-api.lakeshore.internal.
